reference: If you hate the answer, you should not ask the cards.
sk: Ak sa ti odpoveď nepáči, nemal by si sa kariet pýtať.
cz: Když se ti odpověď nelíbí, neměl bys se karet ptát.
acceptable: If you {hate|do not like} the answer, you should not ask the cards.
You should not ask the cards if you {hate|do not like} the answer.

mistakes.text: If you hate the answer, you should not to ask the cards.
If you hate the answer, you {not should|do not should} ask the cards.
If you will hate the answer, you should not ask the cards.
If the answer does not like you, you should not ask the cards.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Nepáči sa mi“ je „I do not like“: „If you do not like the answer“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Nelíbí se mi“ je „I do not like“: „If you do not like the answer“.

mistakes.text: If you hate the answer, you should not ask cards.

source_issues: Native sentences say 'nepáči sa ti / nelíbí se ti' (don't like), milder than 'hate'; both accepted.
